caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain beige or light tan background. The object is a lamp with a spherical, transparent blue glass reservoir or globe, which has visible highlights and reflections indicating its glossy surface. The globe sits on a multi-tiered, dark blue base with three concentric, scalloped layers stacked one above the other, progressively smaller towards the top. The lamp's neck and supporting structure are also rendered in shades of blue with realistic shading. There are no other objects, patterns, or significant details in the background. The composition is simple, with the lamp positioned centrally and occupying the lower half of the image. The artist's signature appears in the bottom right corner.
